description: Manifest for the materialized frozen standard stock-model workbook shell. The shell file exists at templates/standard_stock_model_template.xlsx and future runtime may write values only to declared writable zones.

ticker_sheet_token_rule.rule: Replace {ticker} with the uppercase ticker only for the resolved workbook sheet name; bindings and manifest keep the tokenized name.

owns: sheet names and tokenized investment-case sheet

intentionally_ignored.sheetView.topLeftCell: Scroll position is application/session state and does not change the frozen layout.
intentionally_ignored.selection.activeCell: Active-cell state is volatile and may change when Excel opens or saves the workbook.
intentionally_ignored.selection.activeCellId: Selection bookkeeping is volatile application state.
intentionally_ignored.selection.sqref: Selected ranges are user/session state, not template layout.
intentionally_ignored.selection.pane: The active selection pane is user/session state; pane geometry remains signed.
intentionally_ignored.workbook.activeTab: The currently focused tab is session state; per-sheet tabSelected is normalized and signed.

planner_cell_contracts.target_role: current secondary guidance notes and source
